entities.summary: Hirofumi Nakasone  is a Japanese politician who served as a Minister for Foreign Affairs from September 2008 to September 2009. A member of Liberal Democratic Party, he was also served as a Minister of Education under Prime Ministers Keizō Obuchi and Yoshirō Mori. He is the son of Prime Minister Yasuhiro Nakasone.
